source_limitations: American SPY physical settlement not modeled

signal.momentum_sign: UP when close_D > close_Dminus3; else DOWN
signal.evaluation_schedule: every third valid common SPY options trading session after 20 sessions, D to D+1 entry EOD to D+2/D+3 EOD <=72 wall clock hours; no overlap across arms
signal.underlying_rvol10_from_prior_10_closed_s: required only if volume exists; if missing report feature unavailable and block any RVOL-conditioned model
signal.iv_divided_by_trailing20_realized_vol: feature measured on decision day D, nonmissing only
signal.candidate_choice: deterministic closest abs(delta) to .08 then higher OI then volume then contract_id; vertical short nearest strike one to five dollars further OTM same expiry and right, long leg frozen at D

observations.events: at D+2/D+3 observed EOD exit BBO mark net of modeled costs; first observed target or stop wins, otherwise TIME at D+3; no fill proof; no quotes -> CENSORED and audit; holding <=72h
observations.conditional_model: Beta(1,1) probability of TP given resolved episodes, per right and IV_discount flag, use overall side fallback if n<8; 95% Wilson interval; no post-validation fit
observations.pnl_estimator: mean training realized net USD by right+IVregime, including negative and censored-as-zero liquidation; uncertainty and lower confidence using conservative standard error, never GO with missing exits

execution.entry: contract chosen D only; D+1 option ask+.01 proxy, IOC ceiling min(.45,ask_D*1.2+.03); filled in model iff next observed ask+.01<=ceiling; no real execution
execution.exit: D+2 or D+3 BBO bid-.01 for long; vertical exit long bid - short ask with slip .01 per leg; missing terminal exit full premium loss, not dropped

model_validation.grouping: right + IV_discount vs 20d annualized realized vol
model_validation.multiplicity: all exploratory; no familywise confirmed GO
